# Sources

<!-- Generated by `dotnet run --project tools/update-db -- gen-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every datum in Shiftwall's model database comes from an official Fortinet source and records the date it
was last checked. Data without a reliable source is marked **unverified**: the app shows a warning and
never relies on it silently. A real factory-default backup of the target model always takes precedence.

Accepted hosts: `docs.fortinet.com`, `www.fortinet.com`, `community.fortinet.com`, `fortinetweb.s3.amazonaws.com` (S3 only for attachments linked from docs.fortinet.com).

## Summary

- Models: **34**
- FortiOS releases: **96** (6.2.0 – 8.0.2)
- Fields verified: **338**, unverified: **52**
- Upgrade paths: none listed — see below

## Upgrade paths

Fortinet publishes supported upgrade paths only through the interactive Upgrade Path Tool. Shiftwall does not scrape it and lists no paths: the app opens the official tool in the browser instead.

Official tool: <https://docs.fortinet.com/upgrade-tool/fortigate>

- [FortiOS 7.6.8 Release Notes - Upgrade information](https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/7.6.8/fortios-release-notes/832438/upgrade-information) — verified 2026-11-15 — "Supported upgrade path information is available through the Upgrade Path Tool on the Fortinet Document Library."
